expressions.name: Loop Cycle
expressions.desc: Repeats keyframes in a continuous forward cycle.
expressions.tags: loop repeat cycle forward
expressions.code: loopOut("cycle");

expressions.name: Loop Ping-Pong
expressions.desc: Repeats keyframes forward then backward, endlessly.
expressions.tags: loop pingpong bounce mirror
expressions.code: loopOut("pingpong");

expressions.name: Loop Offset
expressions.desc: Repeats keyframes, each cycle offset by the last value.
expressions.tags: loop offset continue accumulate
expressions.code: loopOut("offset");

expressions.name: Loop In (Cycle)
expressions.desc: Loops keyframes before the first keyframe.
expressions.tags: loop in before start cycle
expressions.code: loopIn("cycle");

expressions.name: Loop In (Ping-Pong)
expressions.desc: Ping-pong loop before the first keyframe.
expressions.tags: loop in before start pingpong
expressions.code: loopIn("pingpong");

expressions.name: Loop N Times
expressions.desc: Loops keyframes a set number of times then stops.
expressions.tags: loop limited count times

expressions.name: Wiggle
expressions.desc: Random organic motion — the classic camera shake / jitter.
expressions.tags: wiggle random shake jitter handheld
expressions.code: wiggle(5, 25);

expressions.name: Smooth Wiggle
expressions.desc: Wiggle with a low frequency for slow, drifting motion.
expressions.tags: wiggle smooth slow drift float organic
expressions.code: wiggle(0.5, 50);

expressions.name: Wiggle X Only
expressions.desc: Wiggles only horizontally — good for a side-to-side shake.
expressions.tags: wiggle horizontal x axis one shake
expressions.code:
var w = wiggle(5, 30);
[w[0], value[1]];

expressions.name: Wiggle Y Only
expressions.desc: Wiggles only vertically.
expressions.tags: wiggle vertical y axis shake
expressions.code:
var w = wiggle(5, 30);
[value[0], w[1]];

expressions.name: Wiggle Fade Out
expressions.desc: Wiggle that fades to zero over time — a shake that settles.
expressions.tags: wiggle fade out decay settle dampen

expressions.name: Posterized Wiggle
expressions.desc: Stepped random values — jumps to a new position N times per second.
expressions.tags: wiggle posterize step jump snap random hold

expressions.name: Random Number
expressions.desc: A random value between min and max, changing every frame.
expressions.tags: random number value range min max

expressions.name: Continuous Rotation
expressions.desc: Spins at a steady speed forever — no keyframes needed.
expressions.tags: rotate spin continuous clock perpetual
expressions.code: time * 90; // degrees per second

expressions.name: Time Counter
expressions.desc: Displays elapsed seconds as text.
expressions.tags: time counter text seconds elapsed stopwatch
expressions.code:
var t = time - inPoint;
Math.floor(t).toString();

expressions.name: Countdown Timer
expressions.desc: Counts down from a start value.
expressions.tags: countdown timer seconds decrement

expressions.name: Sine Wave
expressions.desc: Smooth oscillation — useful for breathing, floating, pulsing.
expressions.tags: sine wave oscillate pulse breathe float bob

expressions.name: Cosine Wave
expressions.desc: Like sine but starts at the peak — pair with sine for circular motion.
expressions.tags: cosine wave oscillate circle orbit

expressions.name: Blink / Flash
expressions.desc: Toggles opacity on and off — a blinking cursor, an indicator light.
expressions.tags: blink flash toggle opacity strobe cursor
expressions.code:
var rate = 2; // blinks per second
if (Math.sin(time * rate * Math.PI * 2) > 0) 100; else 0;

expressions.name: Sawtooth Wave
expressions.desc: Ramps linearly then snaps back — progress bars, loading rings.
expressions.tags: sawtooth ramp linear reset progress

expressions.name: Overshoot
expressions.desc: A spring that overshoots the target and settles — the classic bounce-in.
expressions.tags: spring overshoot bounce settle elastic inertia

expressions.name: Rubber Band
expressions.desc: An exaggerated spring — objects stretch past their target and snap back hard.
expressions.tags: rubber band snap elastic stretch exaggerate

expressions.name: Bounce (Drop)
expressions.desc: A ball dropping and bouncing — each bounce shorter than the last.
expressions.tags: bounce drop ball gravity physics

expressions.name: Scale Pop
expressions.desc: Pops in with a springy overshoot on Scale — great for UI elements.
expressions.tags: scale pop spring appear entrance ui

expressions.name: Link to Slider
expressions.desc: Drives this property from a Slider Control on the same layer.
expressions.tags: link slider control effect rig drive
expressions.code: effect("Slider Control")("Slider");

expressions.name: Link to Checkbox
expressions.desc: Toggle value based on a Checkbox Control.
expressions.tags: link checkbox toggle on off control
expressions.code:
var on = effect("Checkbox Control")("Checkbox");
if (on) 100; else 0;

expressions.name: Link to Color
expressions.desc: Reads colour from a Color Control effect.
expressions.tags: link color colour control effect pick
expressions.code: effect("Color Control")("Color");

expressions.name: Follow Another Layer
expressions.desc: Copies position from a named layer — use as a simple follow / parenting alternative.
expressions.tags: link follow layer copy position parent
expressions.code: thisComp.layer("Controller").transform.position;

expressions.name: Linear Remap
expressions.desc: Maps a slider's 0–100 to any output range — e.g. 0–360 for rotation.
expressions.tags: remap linear map range slider convert scale

expressions.name: Clamp Value
expressions.desc: Keeps the property between a minimum and maximum.
expressions.tags: clamp limit cap min max restrict

expressions.name: Typewriter
expressions.desc: Reveals text one character at a time — the classic typing effect.
expressions.tags: typewriter type reveal text character letter

expressions.name: Format with Commas
expressions.desc: Adds thousand-separator commas to a number — 1234567 becomes 1,234,567.
expressions.tags: number format comma thousand separator

expressions.name: Current Date
expressions.desc: Shows the current date in YYYY-MM-DD format.
expressions.tags: date today current year month day

expressions.name: Random Characters
expressions.desc: Scrambles text with random characters — a decryption / hacker reveal.
expressions.tags: random characters scramble decode hack matrix

expressions.name: Auto-Orient to Path
expressions.desc: Rotates the layer to face its direction of travel.
expressions.tags: auto orient rotation path direction travel face

expressions.name: Orbit / Circular Motion
expressions.desc: Moves in a circle around a center point.
expressions.tags: orbit circle circular motion rotate around path

expressions.name: Parallax Scroll
expressions.desc: Moves slower or faster than a reference layer — depth through speed.
expressions.tags: parallax scroll depth speed layer follow slow fast

expressions.name: Snap to Grid
expressions.desc: Rounds position to the nearest grid point — pixel-perfect placement.
expressions.tags: snap grid round pixel perfect align quantize
expressions.code:
var grid = 50; // grid size in px
[Math.round(value[0]/grid)*grid, Math.round(value[1]/grid)*grid];

expressions.name: Auto Fade In
expressions.desc: Fades the layer in over a set duration from its in-point.
expressions.tags: fade in opacity appear enter entrance
expressions.code:
var dur = 0.5; // seconds
linear(time, inPoint, inPoint + dur, 0, 100);

expressions.name: Auto Fade Out
expressions.desc: Fades the layer out before its out-point.
expressions.tags: fade out opacity disappear exit leave
expressions.code:
var dur = 0.5; // seconds
linear(time, outPoint - dur, outPoint, 100, 0);

expressions.name: Fade In + Out
expressions.desc: Fades in at the start and out at the end — one expression, no keyframes.
expressions.tags: fade in out both opacity auto duration

expressions.name: Maintain Scale in Precomp
expressions.desc: Keeps the layer's on-screen size constant even when the parent comp is scaled.
expressions.tags: maintain scale precomp parent constant size

expressions.name: Flicker
expressions.desc: Random opacity flicker — a candle, a broken neon, an old film.
expressions.tags: flicker random opacity neon candle light old film

expressions.name: Look At
expressions.desc: Points a layer or camera at another layer — a spotlight tracking a subject.
expressions.tags: look at aim point target camera track follow 3d
expressions.code: lookAt(thisLayer.position, thisComp.layer("Target").position);

expressions.name: Scale by Z Depth
expressions.desc: Scales a 2D layer based on a slider to fake depth — no camera needed.
expressions.tags: z depth scale fake 3d perspective parallax

expressions.name: Camera Shake (3D)
expressions.desc: Adds organic 3D camera shake on X Y and Z.
expressions.tags: camera shake 3d handheld wobble earthquake

expressions.name: Value Delay
expressions.desc: Reads this property's value from N frames ago — a simple follow / stagger.
expressions.tags: delay follow stagger offset frames time trail

expressions.name: Index Offset
expressions.desc: Each layer's value shifts by its index — instant stagger across a stack.
expressions.tags: index offset stagger stack layer order cascade
expressions.code:
var offset = 20;
value + (index - 1) * offset;

expressions.name: Marker Trigger
expressions.desc: Changes value when a marker is hit — useful for triggering events.
expressions.tags: marker trigger event cue change at time

expressions.name: Normalize (0–1)
expressions.desc: Converts any value range to 0–1 — useful before passing to other expressions.
expressions.tags: normalize range 0 1 scale convert map

expressions.name: If Layer Active
expressions.desc: Returns different values depending on whether the layer is visible.
expressions.tags: if active visible show hide conditional layer
expressions.code: if (thisLayer.active) 100; else 0;

expressions.name: Comp FPS
expressions.desc: Returns the composition's frame rate as a number.
expressions.tags: fps frame rate comp info
expressions.code: 1 / thisComp.frameDuration;
